business_summary: New City Development Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the property development and investment activities in the People's Republic of China. It also offers general management services, as well as engages in construction materials supply chain business. The company was formerly known as New City (China) Development Limited and changed its name to New City Development Group Limited in May 2012. New City Development Group Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자지주회사인 New City Development Group Limited는 중화인민공화국에서 부동산 개발 및 투자 활동에 종사하고 있습니다. 또한 일반 관리 서비스를 제공할 뿐만 아니라 건축 자재 공급망 사업에도 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 New City (China) Development Limited로 알려져 있었으며 2012년 5월에 New City Development Group Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. New City Development Group Limited는 1998년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 Kwun Tong에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
